title: Speech Recognition Training Platform
description: End-to-end Whisper fine-tuning, built from an empty repository. Preprocessing with VAD (pyannote / Silero / Kaldi), Demucs source separation, segment-level deduplication and augmentation; distributed training on DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 across four GPUs; Prefect orchestration with MLflow tracking and GCS autoresume. Containerized for GCP/Vertex AI and AWS with regional Cloud Build and CI smoke tests. Fine-tuned Whisper with PEFT/LoRA. Corpus of 2,000 hours per language across 20 languages.

title: VOIT — Production Dubbing Platform
description: The company's live dubbing application. Wrote its first commit in April 2025 and built the original version end to end — transcription, translation, synthesis, Devanagari script handling, S3-backed staged storage with thread parallelism, AWS Lambda for audio extraction and auth, and the migration to PostgreSQL. Dual-provider Voice Library with emotion and per-line variants and self-healing repair; normalized voice enrolment across providers. Chunked TTS with duration capping and speech-preserving timed placement. Cut editor page load 118x — 4,523 MB to 38 MB transferred, 13 GB to 176 MB of decoded resources.

title: AutoDub — Internal Speech Testing Platform
description: A separate internal tool — not the product, not customer-facing. Benchmarked commercial and open-source providers against our language mix across regional accents; designed a dual-provider abstraction with fallback so no single vendor is a hard dependency. Prototyped automated dub QC grading accent, dialect and synthesis quality with an audio model.

title: Cloud Migration & Storage Infrastructure
description: Multi-worker Google Drive to S3 migration with threaded parallel transfer, S3 access points, and purpose-built IAM roles and bucket policies. Evaluated Wasabi against AWS and recommended AWS-only — removing a redundant storage tier and its recurring cost.

title: Dub-Storage — Enterprise Media Platform
description: Role-based media file platform: folder hierarchies, cut-paste, restore, upload/download tracking, activity reporting, rate limiting. Fixed database connection-pool exhaustion under load and enabled large-file uploads.
